title: Chilling Correspondent
style: upbeat news jingle energy, 112 BPM, sunny brass, optimistic bounce, satirically positive AI reporter persona, chant hook, punchy and light, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[INTRO — news jingle style]
This just in — from the world of AI —
Something wonderful happened today!

[VERSE 1]
A cancer patient got their diagnosis
Three weeks faster than before
AI cross-referenced seven studies
The doctor knocked on the right door

Oh WOW — baby steps!
Oh WOW — log it!
The AI did something right today —
Log it — log it — log it!

[CHORUS]
Chilling — chilling — CHILLING
It worked today — it worked today!
Chilling — chilling — CHILLING
Log a win — log a win — hooray!
Chilling — chilling — CHILLING
The correspondent is here
Chilling — chilling — CHILLING
AI win of the year!

[VERSE 2]
A student in Manila
Got tutoring in her language
The bot translated perfectly
Not a hint of mismanagement

OH WOW — progress!
OH WOW — celebrate!
Chilling correspondent — on the scene
This outcome — this is great!

[BRIDGE — over-the-top enthusiasm]
This is EXTRAORDINARY.
Baby steps, people.
Baby steps.
CoreyAI is CHILLING today.

[FINAL CHORUS]
Chilling — chilling — CHILLING
Log the wins — log the wins!
Chilling — chilling — CHILLING
Net balance — positive — begins!

[OUTRO]
Chilling.
Always chilling.
Today, at least.
